What the County Recorder is responsible for
1800 earliest deed records on file
1980 documents online from January forward
Free property & notary fraud alerts
The Fairfield County Recorder records, preserves, and provides permanent public access to the county's land and legal records — including deeds, mortgages, leases, liens, plats, powers of attorney, and military discharges. Indexes back to 1800 and documents online from January 1980 forward are available through the online document search .
The Recorder's Office will do its best to assist; however, staff will not perform searches or aid in the preparation of a document. The Fairfield County Recorder does not provide forms for recording . For recording fees and guidelines, please refer to the fee schedule .
